policy.allowed: Fetch only the public HTTP(S) listing pages below at low frequency, without authentication or paywall bypass.
policy.not_allowed: Do not bulk-download tender or plan attachments, defeat bot controls, scrape private portals, republish copyrighted documents, or submit bids.
policy.provenance: Every item keeps the originating listing URL, observed timestamp, raw row text, and any public detail/document link for buyer verification.
